name: Attika Group Ltd.
summary: Attika Group Ltd. operates as an investment holding company with diverse business activities. The firm provides electrical solutions throughout Singapore and specializes in end-to-end interior design and fit-out projects. Its services encompass the entire lifecycle of interior fit-outs, from conceptual design and manufacturing to construction, project oversight, and ongoing maintenance. Established in Singapore in 2014, the company caters to both public and private sector clients.
